title: Software Engineer - Advanced
description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.
  
  
**The Mission: Powering the PLM Digital Thread**
We are looking for a highly skilled
**Teamcenter Development Engineer**
to join our Active Integration team in Pune. Your mission is to maintain and extend the core server-side capabilities of our Teamcenter environment, ensuring that our PLM system remains the robust, high-performance engine at the heart of the digital thread.
  
  
In this role, you will take full technical ownership of the existing
**Teamcenter connector implementation**
used within the Active Integration portfolio. You will lead the transition of legacy data extraction functions to modern
**TCXML or TCJSON-based**
approaches, utilizing an
**AI-based development approach**
to accelerate innovation and ensure high-quality, maintainable code.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Active Integration Connector Ownership & Modernization
* Technical Authority: Take responsibility for the existing Teamcenter connector implementation used in Active Integration.
* Implementation: Lead the development and maintenance of C++ based SOA client connectors and ITK extensions.
* Data Strategy: Lead the transition of legacy data extraction functions to modern, efficient TCXML or TCJSON based approaches.
* AI-Assisted Engineering & Innovation
* Design and prototype AI-enabled engineering solutions using frameworks such as PyTorch and LangChain, including LLM-based workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and intelligent automation use cases relevant to Teamcenter and enterprise integrations.
* Integrate AI capabilities with existing applications and services through APIs, secure data pipelines, and reusable components, with attention to performance, scalability, data privacy, and maintainability.
* Actively explore and apply AI-based approaches to optimize Teamcenter performance, integration efficiency, and developer productivity.
* Server-Side & Client-Side Extensions
* ITK & SOA Development: Design, implement, and maintain Teamcenter server-side code extensions using C++ (ITK) and develop TcSoa services.
* Multi-Language Proficiency: Utilize Java and other modern development skills to support client-side connectivity, integration logic, and supporting tools.
* Integration Endpoints: Develop specific backend endpoints that enable Active Workspace (AWC) user actions to trigger complex integration functions.
* Data Model & Admin Extensions
* BMIDE Excellence: Manage and maintain Admin Data related extensions, ensuring the Teamcenter data model is optimized for performance and scalability via the Business Modeler IDE (BMIDE).
* Quality & Collaborative Engineering
* Peer Collaboration: Actively participate in Peer Programming and Merge Request handling to ensure high code quality.
* Automated Testing: Develop unit and integration tests for server-side and client-side extensions to ensure stability during upgrade cycles.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Skills**
**Technical Competencies**

* Expert proficiency in C++ (for ITK and SOA clients) and strong proficiency in Java and other modern development languages; working knowledge of Python for AI/ML development is expected.
* Practical experience of implementing Teamcenter AIG at customers will be an added advantage.
* Hands-on exposure to PyTorch and LangChain, with the ability to build or integrate AI/ML models, LLM applications, prompt workflows, agents, or RAG-based solutions.
* Practical experience using AI coding assistants and related tools to improve code generation, refactoring, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting, with sound engineering judgment when validating generated output.
* Understanding of REST APIs, embeddings, vector databases, model/service integration, data preprocessing, model evaluation, and secure handling of enterprise data is desirable.
* Practical experience or strong knowledge of TCXML and TCJSON for high-performance data exchange.
* Proven experience in developing and consuming TcSoa services and integrating them with Active Workspace (AWC).

**Soft Skills**

* Solution-Driven: You enjoy finding the best technical solution for the end-user and the business.
* Team Player: You thrive in a collaborative environment and are eager to share knowledge through peer reviews.
* Communication: Good command of English (written and spoken) for effective collaboration with global teams.

**Why us?**
Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
  
  
**Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday**

Role Summary:
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Bluetooth/Wi Fi Developer to design, integrate, customize, validate, and maintain the Bluetooth and Wi Fi software stack for an Automotive Android (AOSP) based In Vehicle Infotainment (IVI) Head Unit. The role requires strong system-level Android connectivity expertise, including driver/HAL integration with a 3rd party chipset vendor, and ensuring automotive grade performance, stability, interoperability, and compliance readiness.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  

* AOSP Connectivity Stack Development & Integration
* Lead bring up and integration of Bluetooth/Wi Fi stack components on Automotive Android OS, aligning with chipset firmware/driver deliverables from the hardware vendor.
* Integrate and customize Android connectivity interfaces including Vendor HAL, Supplicant HAL, and Hostapd HAL, and support transitions across interface mechanisms (AIDL/HIDL) as applicable to the Android baseline.
* Work across Android build and tooling workflows (source sync, build, debugging) and use Android developer utilities for diagnostics and triage.
* Feature Enablement & Use Case Implementation:
* Enable core Bluetooth/Wi Fi functions and implement IVI specific connectivity features/use cases across the program lifecycle.
* Support multi display / multi user or high integration scenarios where connectivity must work reliably across concurrent user contexts
* Design and Develop Bluetooth and Wi-Fi based Audio/Video Streaming solutions.
* Collaborate with platform/system teams to resolve end to end integration issues between connectivity subsystem and the overall IVI platform.
* Quality, Validation & Certification Readiness
* Drive validation, debugging, and optimization for range/throughput performance, stability, and coexistence behavior in automotive environments.
* Ensure readiness for Android platform compatibility expectations including support for annual Android upgrades and CTS/CDD compliance where applicable.
* Support certification readiness activities aligned to Bluetooth SIG and Wi Fi Alliance (WFA) programs (working with test teams/labs and providing engineering support for defects found during qualification).
* Security, OTA, and Lifecycle Maintenance
* Implement and maintain secure connectivity behaviors (e.g., secure pairing, encryption expectations) and support OTA update strategies, including firmware/stack patching and lifecycle updates.
* Own defect triage and long term maintenance, including root cause analysis for complex system issues spanning framework HAL driver firmware boundaries.

Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  

* Strong hands on experience in Android platform/AOSP development with system-level debugging across framework/services and native layers.
* Strong Bluetooth fundamentals: architecture, profiles, common use cases, and Android Bluetooth stack understanding.
* Strong Wi Fi fundamentals: modes/standards (STA/AP, Wi Fi Aware/RTT concepts) and Android Wi Fi architecture understanding.
* Experience integrating Wi Fi HAL surfaces (Vendor/Supplicant/Hostapd) and familiarity with AIDL/HIDL patterns in Android.
* Experience with A2DP, ARCVP, HFP/HSP, BLE GATT/GAP.

title: Senior Staff AI Application Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
We are looking for a senior full-stack engineer who has shipped production applications, and who has owned software that other engineering teams depended on — a framework, SDK, shared library or internal developer platform — living with an abstraction decision long enough to have had to correct it while consumers depended on it. Establishing engineering standards through automation rather than documentation should be instinctive.
  
  
You will be the senior technical owner of GE HealthCare's internal AI engineering platform: the shared libraries, standardised interfaces, code generation tools and automated verification our data scientists and engineers use to take AI solutions into production. It exists to deliver four outcomes for the company:
  
  

* reduce time from working prototype to production from months to days;
* allow data scientists to ship production-grade AI without expertise in cloud infrastructure, deployment, application security or front-end development;
* make security, compliance and consistency automatically enforced properties of every solution, rather than outcomes dependent on scarce expert review;
* allow underlying technologies to be replaced — model provider, agent framework, user interface approach — without rewriting the solutions built on them.

Your accountability is the platform's architecture and public interfaces, the automated verification that enforces our engineering standards, and the versioning and migration approach that keeps it dependable as it evolves beneath a growing number of applications. The role also includes building AI applications end to end yourself — front end, back end and agents — where that is the fastest way to prove a platform capability or unblock a priority use case; the emphasis at this level sits firmly on the platform, with application work serving it rather than competing with it. This is a hands-on senior engineering role with substantial architectural responsibility and organisational influence — not a management position, and not a research position.
  
  
**Job Description**
GE HealthCare's Chief Data and Analytics Office is delivering a portfolio of strategic AI programmes across Commercial, Finance, Supply Chain, Quality, Manufacturing and Operational Excellence.
  
  
The problem this team addresses is structural. Most people creating AI solutions here are data scientists, and it would be neither reasonable nor efficient to require deep infrastructure, security and front-end expertise of them. Every solution must nonetheless reach production as a secure, reliable, observable, supportable enterprise system, and remain so through years of change. That is the central design constraint:
**the platform and its automated safeguards must substitute for a depth of software engineering review that is not available at the scale and pace we require.**
The failures a strong platform engineer prevents — undetected interface drift, poorly chosen abstractions that become permanent, over-broad access permissions, configuration that cannot be reviewed or reversed — are silent, and present months later as an outage, an audit finding or a security incident rather than as a broken feature.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
**Architecture and design**

* Define the platform's architecture and public interfaces: what is offered, what is guaranteed, what is private, and what a version number promises to dependent applications.
* Design isolation boundaries so each significant third-party technology — agent framework, model provider, message queue, data source, UI rendering approach — is confined to a single replaceable component, with automated checks making that a verified property rather than a documented intention. Validate each in practice, for example by running the same agent unmodified on two frameworks (LangGraph and AWS Bedrock AgentCore, say) with equivalent evaluated behaviour.
* Design the interfaces between roles and components as machine-readable specifications with automated verification, so no two teams need to read each other's code to work together reliably.
* Hold the boundary between declarative configuration and executable code — configuration states what, code implements how — preventing the familiar progression by which a configuration format acquires conditional logic and becomes an undocumented programming language with no type checking, debugger or tooling.
* Record architectural decisions formally (options rejected, trade-offs accepted, revisit conditions), and decline unnecessary abstraction in writing and with reasoning. A significant part of this role's value lies in shared capability deliberately not built.

**Engineering delivery and long-term ownership**

* Lead the highest-leverage components hands-on: the agent execution layer, the secure data resolution layer, and the configuration-driven user interface system. This is a building role, not a supervisory one.
* Build selected AI applications end to end — front end, back end and agents — where that is the fastest way to prove a platform capability or unblock a priority use case, and judge what should then be harvested into the platform and what should remain specific to that use case.
* Establish automated verification before the practice it enforces is adopted — a standard that is not automatically enforced does not, in practice, exist — including automated quality evaluation of AI behaviour in the release path, so degraded output prevents release and a change of model or framework can be shown to have preserved behaviour.
* Own backward compatibility and the migration path. The platform will change continuously while dozens of solutions depend on it; making that change inexpensive and safe for consumers is a primary responsibility.
* Prevent version divergence across applications and shared components; run deprecation properly — announce, migrate, remove — and maintain visibility of the platform's own engineering health, acting before it is raised.

**Interfaces with adjacent disciplines**

* Define and maintain the interfaces between this team and adjacent specialist functions — infrastructure, security, data — as version-controlled specifications with automated validation rather than request queues or standing meetings. These cover what an environment provides, what an infrastructure component accepts, what a service requires to run and is permitted to do, what must pass before release, what artefact is deployed and how it is promoted, and what telemetry and service level commitments apply.
* Anticipate and act on the recognised ways such boundaries deteriorate: a request queue re-forming, resources created outside the sanctioned path, release throughput constrained by a single function, divergent standards emerging, or incidents beginning with a dispute about ownership.
* Represent the platform's architecture and trade-offs to enterprise architecture, information security, risk and senior leadership, in terms appropriate to each audience.

**Technical leadership**

* Mentor engineers and data scientists moving into platform and application engineering, and establish a review culture in which human review addresses design judgement and business fit, because formatting, type correctness, security fundamentals and interface compliance are handled automatically.
* Author the guidance, reference implementations and worked examples that let colleagues and AI coding assistants work productively without direct supervision, and set the standard for responsible use of those assistants under named human accountability.

**Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable practical experience. An advanced degree is welcome but not required.
* Minimum 8 years of professional software engineering experience, including demonstrable ownership of a shared library, framework, SDK or internal developer platform relied upon by other engineering teams. This is the essential requirement: not a record of delivering many applications, but an engineer whose software other engineers' software depends on, and who can describe concretely what it cost when an abstraction had to change.

**Software engineering**

* Expert Python: advanced static and structural typing (mypy or Pyright, strict), interface definition, and judgement about where type-level guarantees earn their cost. Strong TypeScript and modern component-based front-end engineering (React), sufficient to design typed component contracts and a design token system rather than only consume them.
* API and interface design and long-term evolution: specification (OpenAPI), generated clients, versioning, compatibility, deprecation. Relational databases and SQL at depth: schema design, migrations, indexing, behaviour under load, injection resistance established structurally rather than by review.
* Testing strategy across unit, integration, interface-contract and end-to-end levels; CI/CD design (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) including shared reusable pipeline components, and the discipline of keeping checks fast enough that engineers do not bypass them.

**AI and Generative AI engineering**

* Substantial production experience with LLM systems: instruction design, tool and function calling, structured output, retrieval-augmented generation and retrieval quality, cost and latency control, characteristic failure modes.
* Hands-on experience with more than one AI agent framework (for example LangGraph, LangChain, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, OpenAI Agents SDK) and demonstrated ability to design a durable abstraction across them — including rigorous reasoning about which capabilities belong in a common, framework-independent agent definition and which do not.
* Familiarity with emerging standards for AI tool and context interoperability (for example the Model Context Protocol), with the judgement to design toward such a standard's shape without prematurely building infrastructure for it.
* Evaluation-driven development at depth: designing evaluation suites and quality measures for non-deterministic systems and using them as a formal release gate.

**Required**
**Cloud and delivery engineering**
*Infrastructure and production operations are specialist disciplines owned elsewhere in the organisation; our applications request what they need through version-controlled declarations validated automatically, rather than by authoring infrastructure or access policies directly. You are*
***not***
*expected to author infrastructure modules, access policies or network components, nor to own cloud estate design, release execution or infrastructure on call. Required at this depth:*

* Strong working knowledge of a major public cloud, ideally AWS: serverless compute (Lambda), messaging (SQS), object and vector storage (S3, S3 Vectors), secret management, managed relational databases (Aurora), content delivery, event routing, managed AI model services (Bedrock) — sufficient to design well against them and reason about cost, quota, scaling and failure.
* Infrastructure-as-code: fluent reading and review (Terraform) — interpret an execution plan, evaluate whether a component's interface meets a requirement, articulate precisely what is missing and why. Access-management design literacy at boundary level: what a grant permits, what a boundary constrains, why least-privilege access is better generated than hand-written, and how to identify an over-broad request in review.
* Observability design (OpenTelemetry): distributed tracing, structured logging, standardised telemetry, service level objectives and error budgets. Supply chain and delivery security: immutable artefact identity, build provenance, secret scanning, dependency vulnerability management, short-lived federated credentials.
* Cost engineering at the level of declared resource requirements: compute sizing, execution limits, model consumption, caching and result limits.

**Leadership and communication**

* Ability to explain a technical design and its trade-offs to executive leadership, to security and risk, and to a data scientist, adjusting the level without losing the substance — and willingness to state clearly when a programme is blocked and what would unblock it.
* Experience leading work where the principal difficulty was organisational rather than technical, with a concrete account of how a cross-team boundary was kept healthy.

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

This role requires strong hands-on experience in embedded C, low-level driver development, Arm processor architecture, communication protocols, real-time software, and hardware/software integration. The successful candidate will be a technical leader who can independently drive complex CAN controller bring-up and driver development, resolve difficult silicon/firmware issues, influence hardware and software architecture, and mentor engineers across the firmware organization.

**What You’ll Achieve**
**CAN and CAN FD Driver**

* Define the firmware architecture and technical roadmap for low-level CAN and CAN FD controller drivers on Arm-based SoCs.
* Develop scalable driver designs for Classical CAN and CAN FD; bit-rate switching (BRS); dedicated TX buffers, TX FIFOs, TX queues, mailboxes, and RX FIFOs; hardware acceptance filters; interrupt-driven and polling operation; timestamping where supported; error handling, diagnostics, and recovery.

**Reliability, and Diagnostics**

**Technical Leadership and Mentoring**

* Demonstrated experience owning complex firmware subsystems from architecture through bring-up, validation, customer integration, and maintenance.
* Experience working in a semiconductor company or embedded platform in a product environment is strongly preferred.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Classical CAN; CAN FD; bit-rate switching; arbitration; error frames and error counters; error-active, error-passive, and bus-off states; acceptance filtering; RX FIFO and TX mailbox/FIFO/queue management; controller/transceiver interaction; nominal and data-phase bit timing.

description:
What You'll Do
  
  
**Role Summary**
As Avalara scales its AI-first enterprise systems, workflows, and automation footprint, we must reimagine how work is automated, orchestrated, and continuously improved across every function. This role exists to establish and engineer an enterprise-grade AI automation and transformation ecosystem, with n8n as a core platform, enabling faster process transformation, intelligent workflow execution, and measurable gains in productivity, quality, and operational scale.
  
  
This is a high-impact individual contributor role responsible for elevating automation standards, reducing manual work and process friction, and enabling AI-powered transformation across the organization.
  
  
**How This Role Elevates Avalara**
This role strengthens Avalara's enterprise automation and transformation capability by establishing scalable, secure, and measurable AI orchestration standards across the organization.
  
  
**This AI Automation Engineer Will**

* Improve operational efficiency and process quality by engineering resilient AI automation solutions and governed platform standards
* Accelerate business transformation and reduce cycle time through reusable automation patterns, CI/CD enablement, and standardized development frameworks
* Enhance employee and customer experience by removing manual bottlenecks, reducing process defects, and increasing AI workflow intelligence
* Advance Avalara's AI-first execution model by embedding agentic automation, intelligent decisioning, and data-driven observability into enterprise workflows

**Bar Raiser Expectations**
**Role**
As a Bar Raiser, this role is expected to elevate the capability and execution rigor of the entire automation and transformation function, not simply contribute as a senior engineer. This includes:
  
  

* Holding high standards for quality, ownership, reliability, and accountability
* Using metrics (automation adoption, cycle-time reduction, SLAs, SLOs, MTTR, cost per workflow) to guide platform and architectural decisions
* Simplifying complex business processes into scalable, governed, and maintainable automations
* Mentoring engineers and contractors to raise automation maturity and talent density
* Challenging technical assumptions constructively and driving measurable improvement
* Leaving every platform, process, and engineering practice stronger than it was before

This role does not only build automation, it transforms how work is engineered, automated, governed, and scaled across Avalara.
  
  
**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**

* Enterprise AI Automation Leadership

+ Own the enterprise-wide AI automation and transformation strategy with n8n as a core orchestration platform
+ Architect scalable, secure, and resilient automation solutions that eliminate manual effort, improve process quality, and reduce operational friction
+ Design hybrid patterns leveraging n8n/Boomi, APIs, event-driven systems, and AI agents to improve reuse, enable intelligent decisioning, and reduce time-to-value
+ Define patterns for embedding AI-driven workflows (LLMs, agents, and decision engines) into business processes across functions
+ Lead architecture reviews and drive best-in-class automation design standards, including AI-assisted design patterns and governance

**Platform Ownership (n8n)**

* Serve as a technical owner for n8n and AI workflow automation initiatives
* Define environment strategy (dev/test/prod), CI/CD pipelines, and governance models to reduce deployment risk and increase release velocity
* Enable AI-powered workflow capabilities within n8n (e.g., agent orchestration, prompt management, model integrations, human-in-the-loop controls)

* Incorporate AI-assisted monitoring, anomaly detection, and intelligent alerting to proactively detect failures, drift, and degraded workflow performance
* Ensure platform scalability, fault tolerance, and high availability for both deterministic and AI-driven workflows

**Standards & Governance**

* Establish enterprise automation development standards and best practices
* Define exception-handling frameworks, retry strategies, naming conventions, security protocols, and approval patterns that reduce production defects
* Create reusable templates, accelerators, and automation design patterns, including AI agent templates and reusable prompt frameworks
* Define governance for AI usage (model selection, cost controls, prompt/version management, data privacy, and auditability)
* Introduce code review processes and quality gates that increase execution rigor, including AI workflow validation and evaluation standards

**Technical Mentorship & Delivery Excellence**

* Operate as a player-coach — hands-on while mentoring engineers
* Guide contractor and external implementation teams to ensure quality and standards adherence
* Lead technical design sessions, workflow reviews, and post-incident reviews
* Mentor teams on designing, building, and operationalizing AI agents and autonomous workflows within business processes
* Promote best practices for prompt engineering, agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop workflows, and responsible AI automation
* Elevate automation engineering capability across the organization, including AI fluency and adoption

**12-Month Success Signals**
**Within The First 12 Months, This Role Will Have**

* Enabled AI-native automation capabilities, including production-grade AI agents integrated into core workflows
* Improved automation reliability and reduced workflow failure rates and/or MTTR
* Standardized automation patterns, including AI-enabled orchestration patterns, adopted across new transformation initiatives
* Implemented measurable observability, including AI performance, business impact, and cost metrics
* Delivered AI-driven automation use cases that reduce manual effort, improve decision-making, or shorten process cycle time across multiple functions
* Raised execution standards across the automation team through mentorship, technical leadership, and AI capability development

What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  
**AI Expectations**
As an AI-first company, Avalara expects this role to embed AI into how automation and transformation work is designed and executed.
  
  
**This Role Will**

* Design and implement AI-enabled workflows and transformation patterns that materially improve speed, automation, and scale
* Use AI tools to optimize development productivity, workflow diagnostics, process analysis, and root-cause investigation
* Identify high-value AI automation opportunities tied to efficiency, reliability, employee experience, or customer impact
* Apply AI responsibly with appropriate governance, security, and risk considerations
* Elevate AI capability across the automation team by sharing best practices and driving measurable adoption

This role must demonstrate applied AI impact — not casual tool usage — and quantify improvements enabled by AI-driven automation and transformation.
  
  
**What You Bring**

* B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (required)
* 10+ years of experience in enterprise automation, workflow engineering, integration engineering, or platform architecture
* Deep hands-on expertise in n8n or Boomi, including building and orchestrating AI-enabled workflows, agents, and cross-functional business automations
* Experience designing API-first and event-driven architectures, including integration of AI/ML services and agent-based systems
* Strong understanding of REST, webhooks, OAuth, JWT, and API security, along with secure integration of AI services and model endpoints
* Experience implementing CI/CD for automation or integration platforms, including deployment and versioning strategies for AI workflows, prompts, and models
* Cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including AI/ML services (e.g., Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) and scalable model integration patterns
* Familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, AI agents, and orchestration frameworks, and how they apply to enterprise automation
* Experience with observability and monitoring, including AI-specific considerations (latency, cost, accuracy, drift)
* Proven ability to influence architecture and technical direction at scale, including driving adoption of AI-powered automation, process transformation, and intelligent orchestration patterns

Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness

Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

description:
****Database Platform Engineer****
****India****
Magnite (NASDAQ: MGNI) is the world’s largest independent sell-side advertising platform. Publishers use our technology to monetize their content across all screens and formats including CTV, online video, display, and audio. Our tech fuels billions of transactions per day! At Magnite, we cultivate an environment of continuous growth and collaboration. Our work impacts what millions of people read, watch, and buy, and we’re looking for people to help us tackle that responsibility with creativity and focus.
  
  
**About The Role**
Magnite is the world's largest independent sell-side advertising platform. Our infrastructure processes trillions of ad requests per day, backed by several hundred database instances spanning on-premise datacenters and AWS.
  
  
The DBA team is looking for an experienced database platform engineer to lead the technical direction for how our databases are built, operated, and scaled. We're maturing the team's hybrid cloud infrastructure, and we need someone fluent in the current industry-standard technologies who can bring those practices to a team with deep operational expertise. We have footprints both on-premises and in the public cloud; our goal is common practices across them, not consolidation onto a single platform.
  
  
This is a hands-on individual contributor role. Your influence comes from the systems you build, the standards you set, and the engineers you mentor. You'll be working with many engineering teams, including software engineering, data engineering, SRE, and production engineering.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Set technical direction
  
  

* Own the architecture of the infrastructure-as-code behind every database platform we run - Terraform for provisioning, Puppet for configuration
* Unify how the team builds tooling and automation across on-premise and cloud, replacing platform-by-platform approaches with common patterns
* Define what production-ready means for a database platform here, and hold new systems to it
* Take on database problems that have no clear owner or defined approach, and define both

Build, don't just specify
  
  

* Build the reference implementations that turn a proposal into the team's default way of working
* Build the golden paths that let engineering teams provision, change, and operate databases without the DBA team becoming a bottleneck including versioned, automated schema change management
* Engage with the analytics team to shape how we incorporate cloud native platforms like Snowflake and Databricks seamlessly.
* Write the design documents and decision records that become the team's institutional memory

Operate, automate, and stay audit-ready
  
  

* Identify systemic sources of operational toil and eliminate them through automation
* Support the team's recurring SOX and compliance audit obligations, including access reviews and change management evidence
* Build those controls and evidence trails into the platform, so audit readiness is automatic rather than manual
* Participate in the team's shared 24/7 on-call rotation

Lead through influence
  
  

* Mentor current team members technically, building platform engineering practice: self-service, versioned interfaces, automation treated as a product
* Set technical direction in design discussions across the organization, and drive adoption of the patterns you establish
* Raise the technical bar of the engineers around you through design review, pairing, and the quality of your own work

**We’re Looking For Someone With**

* 6+ years designing and operating production database platforms at scale
* Deep expertise across relational platforms — MySQL and its variants, PostgreSQL, RDS, Aurora
* Substantial experience running production database platforms at scale in both public cloud and on-premise — managed and self-managed services in AWS or equivalent, plus datacenter infrastructure — and you can speak to where the two genuinely differ
* Several years hands-on with Snowflake or Databricks, with enough depth to guide platform decisions rather than only operate what exists
* Infrastructure-as-code at a scale where module design and state management decisions carry real consequences — strong Terraform, plus configuration management experience with Puppet, Ansible, or Chef (Puppet preferred)
* Schema migration and orchestration tooling — Flyway, Airflow, Jenkins or equivalents
* Fluency in SQL, Python, and Bash — enough to build tooling, not only to operate it

**How You Work**

* A track record of establishing technical standards that teams you don't manage adopted
* Experience growing platform capability in engineers rooted in operations
* Hands-on experience supporting SOX or comparable compliance audits in a database context, and a genuine appreciation for why those controls exist

**Nice to have**

* Adjacent technologies such as Kafka, Hadoop, Aerospike, Kubernetes, or Spark
* Experience with databases in high-volume, low-latency environments such as adtech, fintech, or large-scale e-commerce

**Additional Details**

* Working hours: This role requires substantial daily overlap with US business hours to collaborate with engineering teams across the organization.
* On-call: This role is part of the team's shared 24/7 on-call rotation.

**Perks And Benefits**

* Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage from Day One
* Generous Time Off
* Holiday Breaks and Quarterly Wellness Days
* Equity and Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Family-Focused Benefits and Parental Leave
* Disability and Life Insurance
* Cell Phone Subsidy
* Fitness and Wellness Reimbursement

**Company Culture**
We believe collaboration is essential to success. Magnite’s hybrid schedule includes two days worked remotely (Monday and Friday) and three days on-site (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday). Our offices provide lunches, beverages, snacks, training and development, and office events to support your work week. We also understand you have appointments, families, hobbies, and other commitments. Magnite strives to maintain a healthy work/life integration for all employees so you can bring your best every day - both at work and at home.
  
  
**Magnite Invests In You**

* Career Development Initiatives and a Career Growth Framework
* Culture and Inclusion Programs
* Bonusly Peer-to-Peer Recognition Program
* Community Service and Volunteer Events
* Company-Matched Charitable Contributions
* Mental Health Support

**About Us**
The world's leading agencies and brands trust our platform to access brand-safe, high-quality ad inventory and execute billions of advertising transactions each month. Anchored in bustling New York City, sunny Los Angeles, mile-high Denver, historic London, and down under in Sydney, Magnite has offices across North America, EMEA, LATAM, and APAC.
  
  
Our Commitment: We aim to incorporate a wide range of voices into our Magnite culture, cultivating an environment where employees feel welcomed, cared for, and encouraged to freely share ideas. We are committed to employee growth, collaboration, inclusion, and innovation. We invest in Magnite’s local communities. We seek talent from all backgrounds to champion corporate values of seeing the big picture and being catalysts of change.
  
  
Check out our blog for Magnite announcements and Ad Tech industry news!

description:
**Who Are We?**

Millipixels Interactive is where creativity, technology, strategy, and innovation come together to build meaningful digital experiences. We partner with startups, growing businesses, and enterprise brands to create everything from immersive digital products and marketing ecosystems to transformation-driven technology solutions.

But beyond the work, we’re a team that thrives on ideas, ownership, experimentation, and execution. We like people who take initiative, think beyond the obvious, and bring energy into everything they do.

If you’re someone who enjoys building, collaborating, and making a visible impact — you’ll probably enjoy being here.

**About the role**

We're hiring a Principal Software Engineer (Frontend) to set the technical direction for how we build the front end across a range of digital products. This is not a role where you're handed a spec and a deadline. You'll define the architecture, set the standards, and be the person teams turn to when the hard front-end questions come up: what to build, how to build it, and what to deliberately not build. You'll write code, and plenty of it where it matters most, but your real impact is multiplied through the engineers you mentor, the systems you design, and the practices you establish.

**What you'll actually be doing**

* **Setting the technical vision for the front end:**
  You'll define architecture, standards, and long-term strategy across products, from rendering strategy and state management to design system governance. Not "yours to implement." Yours to decide.
* **Designing systems that scale:**
  You'll architect modular, reusable front-end platforms and shared component libraries so that new products and features ship faster because of what came before.
* **Owning performance, accessibility, and quality:**
  You'll make Core Web Vitals, accessibility (WCAG), and reliability non-negotiable, and catch bottlenecks before users ever notice them.
* **Turning complex designs into polished experiences:**
  You'll partner with design to translate sophisticated UI/UX into responsive, pixel-perfect interfaces across every device and browser, and push back constructively when a better approach exists.
* **Building with modern React and Next.js:**
  You'll make the calls on rendering (SSR, SSG, ISR), routing, state management, and data fetching, and shape API contracts with backend teams so the front end stays fast, type-safe, and easy to maintain.
* **Driving engineering excellence:**
  You'll establish testing strategy, CI/CD best practices, and AWS-based deployment and hosting that keep delivery fast and safe, while paying down tech debt before it compounds.
* **Raising the bar through mentorship and reviews:**
  You'll coach senior and mid-level engineers, run design reviews, and lead code reviews that genuinely improve the codebase and grow the people behind it.
* **Partnering across the business and looking ahead:**
  You'll contribute to technical discovery and roadmap conversations, communicate trade-offs clearly, and track emerging trends, including AI-assisted development, to improve how we build.

**What you bring to the table**

* 8+ years of hands-on frontend development experience, with a track record of owning architecture and technical direction for complex, production-scale applications
* Hands-on Prebid.js experience: header bidding setup, bid adapters and modules, and custom auction logic, price granularity, and floors.
* Ad server and ad-stack integrations, such as Google Ad Manager (GPT), ad-unit setup, lazy loading, and ad refresh.
* Understanding how ads affect page performance, including ad latency, layout shift (CLS), viewability, and bid timeout tuning.
* Privacy and consent frameworks (IAB TCF, GDPR, CCPA), identity solutions, and ads.txt/sellers.json.
* Expert-level proficiency in ReactJS and Next.js, including hooks, rendering strategies (SSR, SSG, ISR), and component-driven architecture
* Strong command of JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript, plus deep expertise in HTML5 and CSS3, with an eye for responsive, cross-browser, and accessible design

* Ensure data quality, security, access control, lineage, and consistency across reporting solutions.
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and provide long-term fixes.
* Support deployments and production releases across reporting platforms.
* Review solutions developed by other engineers and help maintain good engineering standards.
* Mentor junior engineers and share knowledge and best practices across the team.

Good to Have

**Purpose of the Role**

The ServiceNow Developer is responsible for designing, configuring, developing, testing, and supporting enterprise-grade solutions on the ServiceNow platform.

This role requires a ServiceNow developer who can operate effectively in a larger, governed IT organization, where platform architecture standards, security requirements, documentation, testing, release management, and operational readiness are expected parts of delivery. The individual should be comfortable working within structured development processes while also using approved AI-enabled tools to accelerate scripting, improve quality, support testing, and enhance code reviews.

This is a hands-on technical role focused on ServiceNow configuration and development, disciplined SDLC execution, AI-assisted development practices, and strong collaboration with product, architecture, security, infrastructure, platform, and business stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. ServiceNow Configuration and Development**

* Configure, customize, and develop within the ServiceNow platform to support enterprise business processes.

* Develop integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems using APIs, IntegrationHub, MID Server, web services, or other approved integration methods.
* Ensure ServiceNow development follows platform best practices, upgrade-safe configuration principles, and enterprise governance standards.
* Partner with ServiceNow administrators, platform owners, process owners, and business stakeholders to deliver practical and sustainable solutions.

**2. AI-Assisted Development, Testing, and Code Review**

* Use approved AI development tools responsibly to accelerate ServiceNow scripting, configuration analysis, documentation, test generation, troubleshooting, and solution design.
* Apply AI tools as an enhancement to technical judgment, not as a replacement for developer accountability.
* Use approved AI tools to identify ServiceNow test scenarios, strengthen regression coverage, and document potential gaps that require developer validation.
* Participate in AI-assisted review of ServiceNow scripts and configurations while validating outputs for accuracy, security, maintainability, and compliance with enterprise standards.
* Maintain traceability for AI-assisted work by documenting how generated scripts, configurations, and test assets were reviewed and approved through established development and governance processes.
* Stay current on approved AI development practices, emerging capabilities, and responsible-use guidelines.

**3. Governance, Architecture, and Enterprise Standards**

* Work within established enterprise architecture, security, data, and development governance processes.
* Ensure solutions are secure, scalable, supportable, and aligned with approved technology patterns.
* Participate in architecture reviews, technical design sessions, and governance checkpoints as needed.
* Document technical designs, configuration decisions, integration patterns, dependencies, and operational considerations.
* Avoid unnecessary technical debt, duplication, unsupported customization, and one-off solutions that conflict with enterprise standards.
* Incorporate feedback from architecture, security, infrastructure, and platform governance teams early in the delivery process.

* Participate in agile delivery activities, including backlog refinement, estimation, sprint planning, demos, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Develop against clearly defined acceptance criteria and ensure work is fully tested before release.
* Support release management activities including deployment planning, change documentation, validation, and post-release support.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, blockers, and readiness concerns early.
* Communicate progress, issues, and trade-offs clearly to technical leads, product owners, and project stakeholders.
* Understand that “code complete” does not mean “ready for production”; testing, documentation, support readiness, and operational handoff are part of delivery.

* Support QA, UAT, regression testing, and production validation activities.
* Use AI and automation tools where appropriate to improve test coverage and development efficiency.

* Ensure solutions include appropriate logging, monitoring considerations, error handling, and support documentation.

* Ask clarifying questions to ensure requirements are complete, practical, and aligned with enterprise direction.
* Provide technical input on feasibility, complexity, sequencing, and risk.
* Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Help identify opportunities to simplify processes, automate manual work, improve user experience, and reduce operational friction.
* Act as a responsible technical partner who understands both business needs and enterprise technology constraints.

* 3+ years of hands-on experience configuring or developing within the ServiceNow platform.

Gusti Leder is a German brand for natural leather goods, with retail stores in Germany and Austria, an online shop, and teams across Europe and India. We want every team—from the CEO to store managers—to make decisions from fast, clear, and trustworthy dashboards.
  
  
We are looking for our first dedicated BI specialist: someone who understands what colleagues really need from their data, helps us choose the right BI platform, builds a solid data model, and delivers dashboards people actually use.
  
  
**🚀 What Matters Most To Us**

* Numbers You Can Trust: Totals that reconcile with our source systems, clear KPI definitions, and checks that catch problems before management does.
* Understanding the Goal Behind a Request: You look beyond the written requirement, understand how colleagues want to work with the data, and suggest better ways to answer their question.
* Business Sense: You think about cost, speed, and how a dashboard looks to a busy CEO—not only about the technology.
* Ownership: You take a report from requirement to rollout and keep it running.

**🌟 Why Join Us?**

* Direct Strategic Impact: Become our first dedicated BI specialist, helping select our BI platform and building the reporting foundation for retail stores in Germany and Austria, our online shop, and leadership.
* Stable, Overlapping Schedule: Remote work from India with consistent weekday hours (12:30–21:30 IST) that give you at least 7 hours of live overlap with our technical lead in Germany.
* Modern Data Stack & Growth: Work directly with a MySQL-based data warehouse aggregating POS, ERP, e-commerce, and marketing data, supported by a dedicated learning budget (e.g., for Microsoft PL-300).
* Clean, Documented BI Function: Build a lasting data dictionary, clear KPI definitions, and self-help guides in our Outline knowledge base.

**💼 Key Responsibilities**
**📌 Key Requirements**
**✨ Nice to Have**
**📍 Job Details**
**💰 Compensation & Working Terms**
**📝 How to Apply**

* BI Platform Evaluation
* What You Will Do: Run a proof of concept on our real reports, compare options on licence and hosting cost, maintenance effort, performance with wide tables (50+ columns), and visual quality, and present a clear recommendation with a business case. Then set up the chosen tool.
* Requirements & Business Partnering
* What You Will Do: Work with management, marketing, finance, and stores to understand the goal behind each request (e.g., "how does ad spend on channel X change user behaviour Y?"), translate it into KPIs and data needs, and propose solutions—not just build what is written down.
* Data Connections & Pipelines
* What You Will Do: Connect our sources—our base is a MySQL-based data warehouse, with data aggregated from POS, ERP/warehouse systems, the online shop, Google Sheets, and finance files, with new sources added regularly—with scheduled refreshes and monitoring. Specify the structured data you need; our development team helps bring new sources into the warehouse.
* Data Modelling & DAX
* What You Will Do: Build star-schema models and DAX measures (contribution margin, sales, returns, stock, marketing performance) whose totals are correct at every level. Prepare the model so a move to Power BI is straightforward.
* Data Validation & Quality
* What You Will Do: Check the data you work with for duplicates, inconsistent values, returns, and gaps; reconcile figures with the source systems; set up data-quality checks and flag issues to the data team.
* Dashboards & Reports
* What You Will Do: Design fast, readable dashboards for management and stores: wide tables with frozen columns, filters by date, country, SKU, and channel, drill-down, and Excel export.
* Maintenance & Support
* What You Will Do: Keep refreshes, connections, and access rights running; tune performance; manage versions and changes.
* Documentation & Training
* What You Will Do: Keep a data dictionary, KPI definitions, and how-to guides in our Outline knowledge base; train business users.
* Presenting Insights
* What You Will Do: Present findings and recommendations in simple English to colleagues in Germany.
* Hands-On BI Experience: 2–3 years of hands-on experience in BI or data analysis, building dashboards used in production, backed by a degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or similar (or equivalent experience).
* Power BI & Data Modelling: Strong proficiency in DAX (CALCULATE, SUMX, time intelligence, context), Power Query, and star-schema data modelling.
* SQL & Data Warehousing: Solid SQL skills (joins, window functions, and CTEs) on a relational data warehouse (we use MySQL).
* Requirements Thinking & Cost Awareness: Ability to ask "what decision will this support?" and adapt reports to how people actually work, paired with familiarity with a second BI tool (e.g., Looker Studio, Metabase, Tableau, Superset, or Qlik) and understanding of BI licensing models (per user vs. capacity vs. open source) and maintenance costs.
* Communication & Setup: Clear written and spoken English, able to explain numbers to non-technical managers, plus your own laptop, a second monitor, and a stable internet connection.
* Practical AI Usage: Confident using AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Copilot) in your daily workflow to move faster—and critically reviewing the output rather than trusting it blindly. (Bonus if you use AI coding assistants for SQL/DAX or LLM APIs in data automation.)
* Tracking & Marketing Data: Experience with Google Analytics 4, Meta Ads, Google Ads metrics, attribution, and campaign performance.
* Retail & E-Commerce KPIs: Familiarity with retail or e-commerce metrics such as contribution margin, sell-through, and returns.

title: Solution Architect & Technical Pre-Sales Manager
description:
**Who Are We?**

Millipixels Interactive is where creativity, technology, strategy, and innovation come together to build meaningful digital experiences. We partner with startups, growing businesses, and enterprise brands to create everything from immersive digital products and marketing ecosystems to transformation-driven technology solutions.

But beyond the work, we're a team that thrives on ideas, ownership, experimentation, and execution. We like people who take initiative, think beyond the obvious, and bring energy into everything they do.

If you're someone who enjoys building, collaborating, and making a visible impact - you'll probably enjoy being here.

**About the Role**

 

Every strong proposal has a moment where sales promise meets technical reality, and someone has to make sure those two things actually match. At Millipixels, that's you.

You'll own the entire technical pre-sales journey: running discovery workshops that uncover what clients actually need, architecting solutions that hold up under real-world conditions, and standing in front of clients to present, demo, and defend what Millipixels can build. You're the bridge between business development and delivery - making sure nothing gets sold that can't be built, and nothing gets built that wasn't sold right.

This role sits at the intersection of technical credibility and commercial instinct. We're looking for someone who has actually written code and built systems earlier in their career - because that hands-on foundation is what lets you architect solutions that hold up under real scrutiny, not just ones that sound good on paper. You'll need to go deep enough into AI and tech solutioning to earn a room full of engineers' respect, while staying sharp enough on commercial viability to keep a deal moving forward.

**You’ll Be the Person Who**

* **Leads Discovery That Actually Uncovers Something:**

  Runs workshops that go beyond surface requirements to understand what clients really need and what they haven't said out loud yet.
* **Architects Solutions That Hold Up:**

  Designs technical solutions that are robust enough to survive delivery, not just impressive enough to survive a pitch.
* **Owns the Client-Facing Moment:**

  Presents, demos, and fields tough technical questions in real time, turning complexity into clarity for the people across the table.
* **Bridges Sales and Delivery:**

  Makes sure what gets promised in a proposal is exactly what delivery can and will build.
* **Stress-Tests Every Proposal:**

  Ensures each solution is commercially viable, technically sound, and operationally realistic before it ever reaches a client's inbox.
* **Speaks Fluent AI:**

  Understands AI solutions deeply enough to shape them, question them, and explain them - not just reference them.
* **Solves in Real Time:**

  Handles technical clarifications and objections on the spot, without needing to "get back to you."
* **Keeps Solutions Aligned to Reality:**

  Ensures every proposed solution actually reflects what Millipixels can deliver - not just what sounds good on paper - drawing on genuine hands-on engineering experience.
* **Shapes the Proposal, Not Just Reviews It:**

  Gets involved early in proposal solutioning, so technical thinking is baked in from the start, not bolted on at the end.

**You’ll Be a Great Fit If**

* **You've built things before you started designing them:**

  you've spent earlier years of your career hands-on with a programming language - Java, .NET, Node.js, full-stack, or similar. It doesn't matter which; what matters is that you've actually written and shipped code, so when you architect a solution, you understand how it really works under the hood.
* **You're a seasoned technical architect:**

  Typically 9–14 years of overall experience, with genuine depth in solution/technical architecture, not just adjacent exposure.
* **You've been part of actual project delivery: N**

  ot just design and hand-off - you understand what it takes to build what gets promised.
* **Startup scale-up experience is a strong plus: C**

  andidates who've been part of a startup that has genuinely grown are valued more highly than those whose experience is limited only to large service-based organisations - though that background is welcome too.
* **Client-facing exposure helps: P**

  rior involvement in client interactions and/or presales activity is a plus, but not a strict requirement.
* **What really matters: C**

  an you stand in front of a customer's technical team and confidently, accurately answer their questions in real time? Formal presales experience is optional - this ability isn't.
* **Your communication skills are excellent:**

   Fluent enough with engineering heads to discuss what gets built and how, yet just as at ease making deep tech solutions digestible to non-technical stakeholders. This is non-negotiable for the role.
* **You have strong working knowledge of AI solutions**

  and can architect around them, not just talk about them.
* **You're equally comfortable**

  in a whiteboard session with engineers and a boardroom pitch with executives.
* **You think commercially:**

  You know a great solution still has to make business sense.
* **You hold a cloud architecture certification:**

  AWS or Azure (Solutions Architect / Solutions Professional level - Optional).

**Benefits of Working at Millipixels**

* **Flexible work, your way:**

  Work where you do your best thinking. We measure outcomes, not hours at a desk.
* **Life admin handled:**

  Regular expert-led sessions on finance, tax, and healthcare, so the boring stuff doesn’t eat into your weekends.
* **Comprehensive Health Coverage:**

   Company-paid health insurance of ₹500,000, with options to extend to spouse.
* **Generous paid leave:**

   Properly switch off and recharge. We’re in this for the long game, and so are you.
* **Room to grow:**

   Continuous learning and real development in a global team, with space to grow your career as fast as you grow the pipeline.
* **Ground-floor impact:**

   Join early, help shape the GTM playbook, and put your mark on how we grow, including our AI platform, avirat.ai.
* **Ownership, not red tape:**

   Small team, big trust. Bring the idea, run with it, and watch it ship.

title: Software Dev Engineer II
description:
**Description**
Amazon Customer Service handles hundreds of millions of customer contacts each year across every Amazon business. Our Associate Experience Technology (AE-Tech) organization owns the products, platforms, and AI systems that determine how Customer Service Associates (CSAs) handle contacts, compose responses, wrap up interactions, and collaborate with AI—across every contact channel worldwide.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Within AE-Tech, Our Team Owns The End-to-end Associate-facing Tools, Workflows, And AI Capabilities That Power How CSAs Interact With Customers Across Contact Channels. Our Charter Spans Five High-impact Workstreams
  
  
Email Contact Channel & Systems — End-to-end ownership of the Email contact channel, one of the highest-volume and most complex channels in Amazon Customer Service—encompassing email ingestion, routing, associate-facing workflows, response management, and channel-level performance optimization
  
  
Contact Handling & Composition Tools — The systems associates use to handle and respond to customer contacts, including Email Composer, After Contact Work (ACW), annotation systems, and order selection workflows
  
  
Wrap-up Automation & Contact Lifecycle — Intelligent automation that streamlines post-contact workflows, reduces manual documentation burden, and accelerates wrap-up to improve Average Contact Handle Time (ACHT)
  
  
GenAI-Powered Customer Service — AI-assisted composition, automated response generation, intelligent summarization, and full contact automation powered by Large Language Models and Generative AI
  
  
Native Widget Experiences — Modern, performant native widgets that replace legacy page-based experiences, delivering faster and more intuitive tooling for associates across all contact channels
  
  
We are investing deeply in transforming the associate experience through AI and automation. Our team has already automated a meaningful percentage of contacts and delivered millions in annualized cost savings, and we are just getting started. The opportunity ahead includes scaling automation across channels, building next-generation GenAI-powered tools, and creating intelligent workflows that make every associate more effective.
  
  
This is a high-impact, hands-on engineering role. You will own the design, implementation, and delivery of key features and services across these workstreams—writing production code, building scalable systems, and contributing to the tools and platforms that hundreds of thousands of associates use every day to serve Amazon customers worldwide.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer ( SDE II) within AE-Tech, you will be a core builder on the team—taking ownership of features and components, delivering high-quality code, and contributing to system design decisions. You will work at the intersection of associate experience, Generative AI, and operational efficiency—collaborating with senior engineers, SDMs, Product Managers, Applied Scientists, and Business Intelligence Engineers across India and North America to deliver systems that improve associate effectiveness and customer satisfaction at global scale.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, build, and deliver features across the Email contact channel and associate-facing systems — own end-to-end feature delivery for email contact handling workflows, Email Composer, ACW, Wrap-up Automation, annotation systems, and native widget experiences, from design through production deployment
* Contribute to GenAI-powered capabilities — implement AI-assisted composition, automated response generation, and intelligent summarization features by integrating LLMs, building prompt pipelines, and developing model orchestration components
* Build and maintain scalable, reliable services — write clean, well-tested, production-quality code; design APIs, data models, and service interfaces that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements across the Email channel and broader AE-Tech systems
* Deliver native widget experiences — contribute to the migration from legacy page-based tools to modern, high-performance native widgets that improve associate efficiency and reduce latency across contact channels
* Own operational excellence for your services — monitor, alarm, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues; participate in on-call rotations and drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions
* Participate in and contribute to technical design — author design documents for your features, participate in team design reviews, and provide constructive feedback in code reviews to improve overall code quality
* Collaborate effectively across teams — work with AE-Tech and partner teams (Routing, Quality, Applied Science, Operations) to understand requirements, resolve dependencies, and deliver integrated solutions
* Grow and help others grow — actively seek feedback, invest in your own technical development, and mentor junior engineers through code reviews, pairing sessions, and knowledge sharing

**About The Team**
Our team is focused on building reliable, scalable software that serves Amazon customers worldwide. We value collaboration, technical rigor, and a genuine commitment to quality. Engineers here have the autonomy to propose solutions, drive improvements, and grow their skills in a supportive environment. We are investing in new technologies and approaches to solve increasingly complex challenges, and we are looking for engineers who want to help shape that future alongside us.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
